newsitem.title: UK: OPEC Oct crude output rises to 26.03 mbpd - IEA.
newsitem.headline: OPEC Oct crude output rises to 26.03 mbpd - IEA.

text.p: Oil production by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) rose by 95,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 26.03 million bpd in October, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said in its monthly report published on Friday.
The Paris-based energy watchdog saw increased supply of 70,000 bpd from OPEC's only Asian member Indonesia, which produced 1.42 million bpd in October.

Iran, OPEC's second largest producer, produced 3.70 million bpd, up 30,000 bpd from September while Nigeria, the only OPEC producer in sub-Saharan Africa, added 50,000 bpd to 2.2 million bpd in October, the IEA added.
OPEC set a production ceiling of 25.033 million bpd for the second half of the year at its ministerial meeting in June, including an extra 800,000 bpd for Iraq.
Including natural gas liquids, October supply from the 11 OPEC members totalled 28.71 million bpd from 28.64 million in September, the IEA said.
OPEC members seeing reduced output in October were Saudi Arabia and Libya, the IEA said.
Saudi and Kuwaiti output includes their equal shares of the Neutral Zone.
